_status: HAND-SET, NEVER FITTED. Every number below was chosen by a person from biomechanical reasoning, not selected against data. `observation_cut` in particular is a descriptive cut, not a decision boundary: it says 'the knee went this far past the toes', not 'this is a fault'.

label_semantics.granularity: intervals in seconds within a clip
label_semantics.meaning: a human marked the moments where knee-forward travel became excessive -- a judgement about DEGREE, against a standard that is not in the geometry
label_semantics.why_not_fitted: 1109 of 1623 clips are positive (68.3%), so an all-positive classifier scores F1 0.812. Between-video AUROC of the peak predicate is 0.572. There is nothing to fit that beats saying yes to everything.

_observation_cut_note: Torso-lengths of knee-past-toe travel at the bottom. Set at 0.05 because the measured within-interval median delta was +0.0785 and half of that is a conservative 'clearly more than nothing'. It was NOT selected by sweeping against labels and no claim is made that it separates anything. Changing it changes a description, not a verdict.
_min_foot_length_note: Below this the heel and toe landmarks are effectively coincident and the sign of the foot direction is noise, which would silently invert the measurement.
_coverage_note: Same floor as depth_v1: below this, too little of the bottom window was measurable to describe anything. Coverage = measurable-frame fraction x foot visibility ramp x view weight.
_visibility_note: From app/ml/posture_v1/visibility.py, so the codebase keeps one visibility vocabulary.
_segmentation_note: Identical to depth_v1.json on purpose: the same bottom window, so the two checkers describe the same instant of the same rep. If these diverge the two decision rows stop being comparable.
_view_floors_note: Knee-past-toe is a SAGITTAL-plane measurement, so it is weakest head-on. Measured agreement was oblique 84%, front 71%, side 70% -- note that side did NOT win, contrary to the prediction made before the run. The front floor is down-weighted on the geometry, not on those numbers, which are too few per cell to fit on.

provenance.author: hand-set
provenance.advisory_reason: The combiner must treat this checker as evidence only. It may never set a verdict, because its video-level separation was measured and refuted.
